KI_rich_emoji.md.summary: Provides core emoji parsing, color representation (RGB/triplets/ANSI palettes), Windows console detection/rendering, and library top-level entry points. It translates high-level text embellishments and color palettes into terminal-safe output.

KI_rich_live.md.summary: Manages dynamic terminal updates, animations, multi-task progress bars, HTML/SVG export templates, and IPython integration. It allows real-time interactive terminal applications to refresh without screen scrolling.

KI_rich_null.md.summary: Provides internal mathematical routines, layout ratio solvers, text wrapping primitives, platform Win32 console structures, and base ABC protocols. It forms the low-level foundation for rendering algorithms.

KI_rich_align.md.summary: Central pipeline of Rich: houses the primary `Console` class, ANSI escape sequence decoder, cell width calculators, border box constants, and alignment/column containers. It coordinates measurement, rendering, and terminal stream emission.

KI_rich_default.md.summary: Houses split-screen terminal layout panes (`Layout`), pattern regex highlighters (`Highlighter`), JSON syntax formatters, Rich logging handlers (`RichHandler`), default theme color rules, and Jupyter notebook rendering shims.

KI_rich_markdown.md.summary: Provides markdown document parsing, console markup parsing (`[bold red]...[/]`), framed panel containers (`Panel`), recursive object pretty-printing (`Pretty`), user interactive prompts (`Prompt`), and the Rich Console Protocol definitions.

KI_rich_region.md.summary: Defines the atomic rendering primitives of Rich: `Segment` (minimal text+style tuple), `Style` (ANSI attributes container), `Rule` (horizontal dividing lines), `Status` (loading indicators with spinners), and alternate screen buffer controls (`Screen`).

KI_rich_syntax.md.summary: Implements high-level data presentation components: `Table` (grid formatting with auto-wrapping), `Text` (styled character spans), `Syntax` (Pygments code highlighting), `Traceback` (rich exception rendering), and `Tree` (hierarchical tree visualizations).

KI_rich_unicode11-0-0.md.summary: Contains precomputed Unicode East Asian Width lookup tables for modern Unicode specifications (versions 11.0.0 through 17.0.0, plus 4.1.0). These tables determine whether individual Unicode codepoints occupy 0, 1, or 2 terminal character cells.

KI_rich_unicode5-0-0.md.summary: Stores precomputed character width lookup tables for historical Unicode versions (versions 5.0.0 through 9.0.0). It provides backward-compatible East Asian Width measurements for legacy terminal environments and older OS consoles.
